Support for Landscape Mode in mini-programs

This feature is effective for shell-based mini-programs (version 25.3.0 or later) and H5 mini-programs (version 25.6.0 or later).

Enable screen rotation support on your phone Global configuration added: "pageOrientation": landscape If the landscape Mini Program is configured to be displayed in landscape mode, the Mini Program is displayed in portrait mode. Otherwise, the Mini Program is displayed in portrait mode. If pageOrientation is configured, the screen is forcibly displayed in landscape mode.

The following is an example of enabling screen rotation in a single page json file.

Sample Code

{
  "pages": ["pages/index/index"],
  "window": {
    "pageOrientation": "landscape"
  }
}

Bug & Tips

  1. To configure the Mini Program to display in landscape mode, the Mini Program resources must be adapted to display in landscape mode to load normally. Otherwise, it may display a blank screen.
